letter.role_title: Working Student (f/m/d) - SAP AIPD Enterprise Architecture Group
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in the SAP AIPD Enterprise Architecture Group. Making the daily work of enterprise architects faster with AI tools, inside the IT organisation of SAP itself, combines my SAP background with my studies in artificial intelligence.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I was selected as one of 10 participants from Pakistan for the SAP Young Professionals Program, covering S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Cloud Integration
I documented data sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built, so others could reproduce and support them
I prepared and presented SAP Analytics Cloud to a client, who subsequently purchased it

letter.problems_section: I would support your architects with well-structured documentation, Excel and PowerPoint work, and proof-of-concept scripts in Python, and I use ChatGPT and Claude daily. Enterprise architecture tools and frameworks would be new to me, and I am motivated to learn them in depth.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for 20 hours per week for the full duration you ask for, and am happy to relocate to the Walldorf area. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
